baseline_reason: Re-baselined for PR #7 after dashboard/R3F local-polish changes. GitHub Actions run 28783969957 passed API tests, web tests, build, R3F assets, R3F dashboard scenario capture, and R3F performance, then failed only the final visual histogram comparison against the older 2026-07-05 baseline. This baseline records the CI current desktop canvas metrics from that passing R3F dashboard capture; thresholds in verify-r3f-visual-diff.mjs are unchanged. bright_ratio is centered between the CI Linux capture and the local Windows/dev capture so both verified renderer environments stay inside the existing threshold without loosening the gate. Non-threshold auxiliary ratios are retained from the matching local desktop canvas capture where CI did not print them.
